title: Approval of Resolution Authorizing Travel of President Allan T. Marks to
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Board of Water and Power Commissioners
  Approval of Resolution Authorizing Travel of President Allan T. Marks to
  Sacramento, California from October 19, 2026, through October 21, 2026,
  representing the Department and Board of Water and Power
  Commissioners.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Authorize travel for Board President Allan T. Marks to Sacramento from October 19-21, 2026 to represent the Department and Board of Water and Power Commissioners.
